text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, with olive-toned skin and long, dark brown wavy hair. She has a slender build, oval face, and defined eyebrows. Wearing a deep purple, floor-length gown with a V-neck, wide sleeves, and high slit; cinched at the waist by a black belt with gold accents. Standing barefoot in profile, arms slightly outstretched. Other panels show front, back, and close-ups of eyes, lips, ear, hair, and face expressions.
